info.description:
The API provides endpoints for accessing real estate data, including comparable property data, property valuation, and market trends. Users can query the API using various criteria such as property type, location, and contract type to retrieve relevant data.

Some requests are processed asynchronously. In these cases, the API immediately returns a request ID that can be used to retrieve the final result through dedicated GET endpoints.

Optionally, a callback system can be configured to receive automatic notifications when the request is completed. This allows clients to avoid polling and handle results more efficiently.

Overall, the API simplifies access to real estate data, making it easy for developers to integrate property information into their applications.


**IN SANDBOX**

In the sandbox environment, consistent test data will be returned for API requests. This ensures predictability and facilitates testing and development processes. Users can rely on the sandbox environment to receive the same predefined data for various scenarios, allowing them to validate their application's functionality reliably without impacting live data or systems.

CallbackOptions.description: This is our standardized OpenAPI callback system. It enables the configuration of parameters for receiving notifications about status updates of asynchronous requests to this endpoint.

method.description: Specify the callback method. When set to 'POST', a standard HTTP POST request will be initiated with the Content-Type header set to application/x-www-form-urlencoded. The JSON data will be encoded into a key-value pair named data (customizable using the field parameter) within the request body. If the method is set to 'JSON', a direct HTTP POST request will be made with the Content-Type header set to application/json. The raw JSON data will be directly inserted into the request body without any encoding.

field.description: This parameter works in conjunction with the 'method' parameter set to 'POST'. When provided as a string, it determines the name of the parameter that will be sent in the POST request.

url.description: A valid URL capable of handling POST requests must be entered into this parameter. For endpoints requiring authentication, the 'headers' parameter can be used to specify 'basic auth' or 'bearer auth'. The maximum timeout is 30 seconds. If 'retry' is set, the system will retry up to 'retry' times until a 200 status code is received.

retry.description: The maximum number of attempts is defined by the 'retry' parameter. If the maximum number of attempts is reached without a successful status code (e.g., 200 OK), the request is considered a final failure. A time interval is often introduced between attempts to avoid overloading the server. This interval may increase exponentially with each attempt to reduce the impact on an overloaded server. The 'retry' parameter is configured to retry the request only in case of specific status codes, typically those indicating temporary errors (e.g., 502, 503) or network issues.

headers.description: A collection of HTTP headers to be sent with the request. Each header is defined as a key-value pair. Headers can be used for various purposes, including authentication, content negotiation, and custom metadata.

custom.description: This object can be populated with any additional data you wish to include in the callback response. This data will be accessible within the 'custom' parameter of the callback function. You can use this to store and retrieve any relevant information that you need for your application.

RealestateSearchData.description: Response for a normal search: a bare array of matching listings (empty when there are no matches). Each listing self-describes its own type via `type` (sale/rent).

OmiPrevalentPropertyType.description: Label of the prevalent property type for the OMI zone. Can be null or empty.

values.description: One entry per property type/condition combination available for this zone and period. Empty array when no valuation data is available.

exterior.description: Outer boundary of this polygon part, as a list of {lat, lng} points (closed ring: the last point repeats the first).

holes.description: Interior boundaries excluded from this polygon part (holes), if any. Empty array when the part has no holes.

geometry.description: The polygon(s) of the OMI zone. One element per disjoint polygon part (most zones have exactly one); each element carries its own exterior boundary and any holes.

post.description:
The rm_value endpoint allows users to query real estate properties based on various criteria. Users can search by property type, specifying whether they are looking for residential, non-residential, or pertinential properties. Additionally, users can define search parameters such as search radius, minimum and maximum price range, and the period of interest, including start and end dates. Furthermore, users can filter properties by contract type using the provided catastral codes. Searches can be conducted either by address or geographic coordinates, offering flexibility in how users locate properties. Some requests may be processed asynchronously. In these cases, the API returns a request ID that can be used to retrieve the result via GET endpoints. A callback can also be configured to receive automatic notifications when the request is completed.

  `immobili_residenziali`:
  The codes provided represent different categories of residential properties. These codes are used to identify and distinguish various types of properties intended for residential purposes, such as apartments, villas, cottages, and other residential dwellings.
  
  **In this category fall all the codes listed below**:
  
 
  **A01
  A02
  A03
  A04
  A05
  A06
  A07
  A08
  A09
  A11**
  
  
  `immobili_non_residenziali`:
  The codes provided represent different categories of non-residential properties. These codes are used to identify and distinguish various types of properties not intended for residential purposes, such as commercial buildings, offices, warehouses, and industrial facilities.
   
  **In this category fall all the codes listed below**:
  
  
  **A10
  C01
  C02
  C03
  C04
  C06
  D01
  D02
  D03
  D05
  D06
  D07
  D08
  D10**
  
  `pertinenziali`:
  The codes provided represent different categories of properties classified as 'pertinenziali'. These properties are closely related or connected to residential or non-residential properties and may include garages, parking spaces, and other auxiliary structures.
   
  **In this category fall all the codes listed below**:
  
 
  **C02
  C06**

The mandatory fields are:
- **property_type**
- **address** or **latitude** and **longitude**

address.description: Property address. It must be composed of at least 5 alphanumeric characters and cannot exceed 255 characters.

search_radius.description: Search area expressed in meters. Minimum value: 50, maximum value: 20000. Default: 250 if not declared.

min_amount.description: Minimum search amount in euros. Integers without punctuation. Not used as a selective criterion if not declared.

max_amount.description: Maximum search amount in euros. Integers without punctuation. Not used as a selective criterion if not declared.

start_year.description: Start year of the search. Integer from 2019. If not declared, the last 2 years are considered.

start_month.description: Start month of the search. Value between 01 and 12 (zero-padded). If not declared, the current month of the last 2 years is considered.

end_year.description: End year of the search. Integer corresponding to the end year of the search. If not declared, the last 2 years are considered.

end_month.description: End month of the search. Value between 01 and 12 (zero-padded). If not declared, the current month of the last 2 years is considered.

items.description: Contract type selected from the list in description es: A10 C01 C02 C03 C04              C06 D01 D02 D03 D05 D06 D07 D08 D10.

completed.description: The request has been successfully processed and full data is available.

post.description:
The SQM endpoint provides users with detailed information on the value per square meter of properties in a given region. Through parameters such as property type, location, and contract, users can obtain precise data to assess price trends and plan strategic real estate investments. The 'type' parameter offers a selection of property types, such as residential buildings, offices, shops, warehouses, and more, each associated with a unique numerical ID.

The 'type' parameter allows selection from various property types, including:
- 1: Ville e Villini
- 5: Negozi
- 6: Uffici
- 7: Capannoni tipici
- 8: Capannoni industriali
- 9: Magazzini
- 10: Laboratori
- 13: Box e Autorimesse
- 14: Posto auto coperti
- 15: Posto auto scoperti
- 19: Abitazioni in stabili signorili
- 20: Abitazioni in stabili civili
- 21: Abitazioni in stabili economici

post.summary: Retrieve detailed property information including sales and demographic data
post.description:
The SQM Advanced endpoint enhances the standard SQM service by providing comprehensive insights into property valuation trends and market dynamics. In addition to the core parameters available in the basic SQM endpoint, the Advanced endpoint offers additional data fields, including:

Detailed breakdowns of property sales distribution by type, facilitating a deeper understanding of market segmentation.

Demographic statistics such as population density, household composition, education levels, and employment rates, offering valuable socio-economic context for investment decisions.

Geographic information including altitude, local administrative divisions, and seismic risk assessment, providing crucial geographical insights for risk management and location-based strategies.

Timeliness metrics indicating average selling durations across different property size categories, aiding in forecasting and decision-making processes.

This enriched dataset empowers users with comprehensive analytics to make informed real estate investment decisions and optimize portfolio strategies.

In some cases, the request may complete successfully but return a non-positive outcome. This is indicated by the 'esito' field (e.g. 'wrong address'), meaning that the request was processed but no valid results could be produced based on the provided input.

get.summary: Search real estate listings near a point
get.description: Searches individual property listings near the given geographic point, sorted by distance ascending.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Latitude of the search point, in decimal degrees.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Longitude of the search point, in decimal degrees.

parameters.name: search_radius
parameters.description: Maximum distance from the search point, in meters. Optional: when omitted, the nearest valid listings are returned with no maximum distance. Mandatory (and must be > 0) when dry_run=1, in which case it also cannot exceed 100,000 meters (100 km).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of listings to return. Default 20, minimum 1, maximum 100.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of matching listings to skip before returning results, ordered by distance ascending.

parameters.name: min_amount
parameters.description: Minimum price, must be >= 0. If max_amount is also set, max_amount must be at least 20,000 greater than min_amount when type=sale (default), or at least 300 greater when type=rent.

parameters.name: max_amount
parameters.description: Maximum price, cannot be lower than min_amount. Must be >= 0. If min_amount is also set, it must be at least 20,000 lower than max_amount when type=sale (default), or at least 300 lower when type=rent.

parameters.name: min_sqm
parameters.description: Minimum total surface in square metres. Must be >= 0.

parameters.name: max_sqm
parameters.description: Maximum total surface in square metres. Cannot be lower than min_sqm. Must be >= 0.

parameters.name: min_rooms
parameters.description: Minimum number of rooms. Must be >= 0.

parameters.name: max_rooms
parameters.description: Maximum number of rooms. Cannot be lower than min_rooms. Must be >= 0.

parameters.name: min_bedrooms
parameters.description: Minimum number of bedrooms. Must be >= 0.

parameters.name: max_bedrooms
parameters.description: Maximum number of bedrooms. Cannot be lower than min_bedrooms. Must be >= 0.

parameters.name: min_bathrooms
parameters.description: Minimum number of bathrooms. Must be >= 0.

parameters.name: max_bathrooms
parameters.description: Maximum number of bathrooms. Cannot be lower than min_bathrooms. Must be >= 0.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by type.

parameters.name: property_category
parameters.description: Filter by property category.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: When set to 1, no listing is returned: the response only reports the total number of valid matches (see 200 response `dry_run` example). search_radius becomes mandatory in this case. When omitted or 0, behaves as a normal search.

value.message: No listings available for the selected search criteria.
